sources.name: lerchen3/kalshi-orderbook-alpha
sources.decision: Inspected metadata and README only; one calendar day cannot satisfy C0. Earnings coverage not established.

sources.name: DepthFeed
sources.decision: Docs emphasize crypto and sports historical books; no verified earnings-call depth history. API key required. Related KalshiPriceData/KalshiBacktesting sites are not independent sources.

sources.name: ProbSights
sources.decision: Advertises Kalshi historical books/trades on Builder with 60-day history and 1m/5m sampling. No authenticated earnings sample or exact capture timestamps checked. A rolling 60-day window on September 30 is within Q3 and cannot alone meet the two-quarter floor.

sources.name: KalshiBackTest
sources.decision: Free sample is recent crypto 15-minute markets; not the earnings-mention universe.

sources.name: Strux
sources.decision: Published corpus covers 2017–2024; not the eight most recent prior calls for these 2026 fixtures. Associated investment labels were not used.

sources.name: EarningsCall
sources.decision: Paid transcript history and speaker features available; exact historical publication versions not demonstrated by product availability. Not purchased; would not resolve missing Kalshi depth.

sources.name: Meta investor archive
sources.decision: Full quarterly call transcripts and separate follow-up-call transcripts available. Eight point-in-time versions not audited in this run. Do not concatenate follow-up calls unless contract rules include them.
